buyer_questions.question: How many documents and tokens are in the corpus today, per monthly dump, and after your own filtering - counted with which tokenizer?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: Datasheets ask 'How many instances are there in total'; labs compare against FineWeb (15T), Nemotron-CC (6.3T), RedPajama-V2 (30T filtered) and need apples-to-apples token counts to size runs.

buyer_questions.question: Is the 100B-document index a sample of the crawlable web or the full set, and what is the sampling/prioritisation policy for which URLs get fetched?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: Datasheets: 'Does the dataset contain all possible instances or is it a sample... what was the sampling strategy?' Crawl frontier policy decides topical and domain skew.

buyer_questions.question: What is the breakdown by language, top-level domain, content type (HTML, PDF, forum, news, code) and publication date?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: HF dataset card 'Dataset Structure' and Data Cards 'Representation' sections; FineWeb2 and Dolma report per-language and per-source token shares that labs use to plan mixtures.

buyer_questions.question: Which sites or categories are deliberately excluded (paywalls, adult, known spam, government, social platforms), and what fraction of the crawl frontier does that remove?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: Datasheets 'Is any information missing from individual instances?' and AI2's OLMo 3 policy of not collecting from sites that disallow it or are paywalled - buyers need the exclusion list to reason about gaps.

buyer_questions.question: How much of the corpus is machine-generated or AI-rewritten text, and do you tag it?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: Nemotron-CC adds synthetic rephrasing to CC text; labs want to control the synthetic share themselves and avoid training on model output unknowingly.

buyer_questions.question: What text extractor do you use (trafilatura, resiliparse, custom) and can we get raw HTML/WARC as well as extracted text?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: FineWeb (trafilatura) and DCLM (resiliparse) show extractor choice moves benchmark scores; labs want raw HTML to re-extract with their own tooling.

buyer_questions.question: Which heuristic filters are applied by default (Gopher, C4, line-level rules, language ID threshold) and can every filter be switched off so we receive the unfiltered stream?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: FineWeb documents Gopher/C4-style filters plus its own line-level rules; Nemotron-CC argues reduced heuristic filtering retains 4x more unique tokens - buyers want control, not a vendor's taste.

buyer_questions.question: Is the processing software available for inspection or reproduction, and is each dump versioned with the pipeline version that produced it?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: Datasheets: 'Is the software that was used to preprocess/clean/label the data available?'; Dolma open-sourced its toolkit, setting the reproducibility bar.

buyer_questions.question: What per-document quality signals ship with the data (model-based quality scores, educational score, perplexity, language score, 40+ RedPajama-style signals) and how were the classifiers trained?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: RedPajama-V2 ships 40+ quality signals; DCLM found fastText model-based filtering is 'key to assembling a high-quality training set'; FineWeb-Edu's classifier lifted MMLU/ARC.

buyer_questions.question: Do you attach topic/format/complexity taxonomy labels per document so we can carve domain subsets (math, code, STEM, medical) without re-labelling?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: Essential-Web v1.0 labels every document with a 12-category taxonomy and shows simple filters recover near-SOTA domain subsets.

buyer_questions.question: What are the known errors, noise and boilerplate rates (navigation text, cookie banners, truncated pages), measured how?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: Datasheets: 'Are there any errors, sources of noise, or redundancies in the dataset?'; Data Cards 'Known Limitations'.

buyer_questions.question: What deduplication is applied - exact, URL, MinHash near-dup, Bloom filter, exact-substring - at what granularity (document, paragraph), and is it per-dump or global across all history?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: FineWeb found per-snapshot MinHash beat global dedup; Nemotron-CC uses global dedup; GneissWeb uses exact-substring; Dolma does URL, document and paragraph dedup. The choice changes token yield and benchmark results.

buyer_questions.question: When a page is re-crawled in a later month, do we get the new version, a diff, or both, and is the earlier version retained?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: Datasheets maintenance questions ('Will older versions continue to be supported?'); continual-pretraining buyers need to avoid re-ingesting the same page every month.

buyer_questions.question: What overlap does the corpus have with Common Crawl, FineWeb, DCLM-Pool, Dolma and RedPajama-V2, and can you ship an overlap report so we only pay for net-new documents?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: Zyda-2 was built by cross-deduplicating FineWeb, DCLM and Dolma; labs already hold those sets and value only the delta.

buyer_questions.question: Which evaluation benchmarks have you decontaminated against (MMLU, GSM8K, HumanEval, ARC, HellaSwag, your NEEDLE set), with what n-gram/overlap method, and do you ship the hit list rather than silently dropping?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: DCLM runs benchmark decontamination checks on DCLM-Baseline; Dolma decontaminates against its eval suite; labs must report contamination in model cards.

buyer_questions.question: Can we get an acquisition timestamp per document so we can build point-in-time cuts and prove no post-cutoff leakage into a given run?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: Datasheets: 'Over what timeframe was the data collected?'; look-ahead bias literature (DatedGPT, PIT models) needs date-bounded corpora.

buyer_questions.question: What toxicity, NSFW and CSAM screening is applied, with which classifiers and thresholds, and what are the measured residual rates?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: Datasheets: 'Does the dataset contain data that, if viewed directly, might be offensive...?'; Dolma applies toxicity filtering; EU template asks about removal of illegal content.

buyer_questions.question: How is PII handled - masked (emails, IPs, phone numbers like FineWeb/Dolma), removed, or left raw - and can we get the unmasked stream under contract?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: HF dataset card 'Personal and Sensitive Information'; FineWeb anonymizes PII; Datasheets ask whether individuals can be identified.

buyer_questions.question: Which crawler user-agent fetched the data, does it honor robots.txt and the common AI opt-out tokens (GPTBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended style disallows), and is opt-out applied retroactively to already-collected pages?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: EU AI Act training-content template requires naming crawlers and stating whether robots.txt was respected; Apertus retroactively applied robots.txt exclusions - the strictest public bar.

buyer_questions.question: Do you honor TDM reservations under EU Directive 2019/790 Art. 4 and machine-readable rights signals (ai.txt, TDM-Reservation headers), and how is the Common Crawl-style opt-out ledger maintained?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: Aleph Alpha's Pharia card states Directive 2019/790 compliance; EU template's data-processing section asks about respect for opt-out mechanisms.

buyer_questions.question: Under what licence is the corpus delivered, what training and derivative rights are granted, and do you indemnify against copyright claims arising from the data?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: Datasheets: 'Will the dataset be distributed under a copyright or other IP licence?'; HF cards require a licence field; enterprise labs (IBM Granite) sell indemnified models.

buyer_questions.question: Do any third-party restrictions, export controls or jurisdiction limits apply, and which regions' data (e.g., EU personal data under GDPR) are excluded or handled differently?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: Datasheets: 'Have any third parties imposed IP-based or other restrictions?' and 'Do any export controls or other regulatory restrictions apply?'

buyer_questions.question: Can you supply the per-source information needed for our EU AI Act Article 53(1)(d) public training-content summary (crawler names, periods, domain lists, opt-out handling)?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: The EU template (24 July 2025) sets a minimal baseline of information GPAI providers must publish about web-crawled data; a vendor that cannot fill it creates a filing gap.

buyer_questions.question: What is the record schema (URL, fetch time, HTTP headers, raw HTML, extracted text, language, quality scores, dedup cluster id), and in what container format (WARC, JSONL, Parquet) and compression?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: HF dataset card 'Dataset Structure' asks for a description of fields; labs' loaders are built around FineWeb/Dolma-style Parquet or JSONL with fixed field names.

buyer_questions.question: How is a monthly dump delivered (S3/GCS bucket, egress fees, on-prem drive), how large is it, how long after month-end does it land, and what SLA covers late or corrupt shards?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: Datasheets distribution/maintenance: 'How will the dataset be distributed?', 'When will the dataset be distributed?', 'Will the dataset be updated... how often?'

buyer_questions.question: Can we get a representative sample shard (say 1-10B tokens) and the full column statistics before signing, under an evaluation licence?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: Data Cards 'Inspect' and 'Audit' stages assume reviewers can examine the data before use; labs run ablations before committing budget.

buyer_questions.question: What ablation results do you have - a 1B-7B model trained on N tokens of your corpus versus FineWeb/DCLM/Nemotron-CC at matched compute, on MMLU, ARC, HellaSwag and a core-eval suite - and can we reproduce them?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: FineWeb, DCLM (53 tasks, 412M-7B) and Nemotron-CC (8B/15T: +5 MMLU vs Llama 3.1 8B) all prove data quality with matched-compute ablations; a corpus without them is unproven.

buyer_questions.question: What is the median and p95 age of a page at delivery, what share of each dump is net-new URLs versus re-fetches, and how do you decide re-crawl cadence per site?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: Data Cards 'Version and Maintenance' and Datasheets 'Over what timeframe was the data collected?'; the sales claim (+20B/mo vs CC's 3-5B pages/mo) must be backed by age distributions.

buyer_questions.question: What exactly is priced - full index, monthly deltas, filtered tiers, raw HTML add-on - per token or per document, and what happens to our rights to already-delivered data if we stop paying?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: Datasheets distribution questions on licence and terms; comparables are Brave's 'Data for AI' training-storage enterprise plans and Datology's per-customer curation contracts.

buyer_questions.question: Who maintains the corpus, how do we report errata or request takedowns, is there a changelog per dump, and will older dumps stay hosted for reproducibility?
buyer_questions.why_buyers_ask: Datasheets maintenance: 'Who will be supporting/hosting/maintaining the dataset?', 'Is there an erratum?', 'Will older versions continue to be supported?'; HF cards require a dataset card contact.
